verdict.rationale: Steel documents an explicit CAPTCHA stance: automatic solving is built into the stealth mode (one flag covers detection/solving/verification) with a dedicated captcha-solving doc and API endpoints, plus human-in-the-loop debug URLs for manual takeover as fallback, avoiding silent failures. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that captcha solving actually succeeds in practice and clearer documentation of failure/error signaling when solving fails.
